messages:
sara.h: Heads-up — after the RBAC refactor I just saw a canary rollback done by a non-ops user. This looks like a policy mis-eval on the new role mapping. @devon can you take a look?

devon: saw that too. reproducing now. seems tied to the deploy token KMS decrypt path returning a minimal principal, which then gets mapped to legacy permissive rules. :thinking_face:

kevin_m: which principal? service-account for the console UI?

sara.h: yes, the console UI SA: `sa-console@redwood-prod`. It used to map to role `release_viewer`, after refactor it sometimes gets `release_operator` when the decrypt call fails and fallback code runs.

kevin_m: that's bad. fallback should never escalate. can you paste the diff from the RBAC change?

devon: here — small excerpt from the refactor that changed the mapping order:

```
- // old: explicit mapping order
- mapPrincipalToRole(principal) {
-   if (isConsoleSA(principal)) return 'release_viewer';
-   if (hasCapability(principal, 'canary_control')) return 'release_operator';
- }
+ // new: inferred capabilities override explicit mappings
+ mapPrincipalToRole(principal) {
+   if (hasCapability(principal, 'canary_control')) return 'release_operator';
+   if (isConsoleSA(principal)) return 'release_viewer';
+ }
```

devon: the problem is the KMS decrypt path returns an empty capability set on timeout, and our capability inference defaults to true for any unknown principal in the new code. bug.

kevin_m: reproducible locally with a simulated KMS timeout. had to force a 504 and then the mapping picked operator.

tess: we need an emergency fix. options: revert mapping order, make inference default deny, or short-circuit on KMS errors to treat principal as unauthenticated. 

sara.h: prefer short-circuit + log + metric. we also need audit logs for any fallback decisions so we can signal SRE/Comms if there are any user-facing rollbacks.

audit-bot: Note: deploy canary start event (deploy-id: cnr-2026-03-20-7) was recorded at 1772549900. No rollback event found in audit log for that deploy-id.

deploy-bot: Canary deploy cnr-2026-03-20-7 completed with health=degraded, auto-rollback triggered by policy. Initiated by actor: sara.h (UI).

security-oncall: quick checklist: 1) stop further auto-rollbacks by disabling canary RBAC for console users, 2) patch mapping logic, 3) run audit replay for past 24h, 4) rotate any tokens if misuse suspected.

devon: pushing a patch to short-circuit on KMS errors now. draft change:

```
+ if (kmsResponse.error) {
+   log.warn('KMS decrypt failed, treating principal as unauthenticated', {principal});
+   emitMetric('auth.kms_decrypt.fail', 1);
+   return 'anonymous'; // maps to least-privileged
+ }
```

kevin_m: LGTM. also add an explicit unit test for KMS timeout mapping and an integration test in the canary flow.

tess: doing the disable: toggling feature-flag `canary.ui_control_enabled` -> false for orgs until patch lands. will signal in #eng-releases.

sara.h: thanks. one more ask — can we have audit-bot surface fallback decisions as structured audit entries? right now fallback logic is opaque. I want entries like `fallback_type`, `source`, `reason`.

audit-bot: Feature request acknowledged. Current audit schema: `{event, actor, timestamp, details}`. Propose adding `details.fallback` object.

security-oncall: also put together a quick vuln triage: did the mapping change open any privilege escalation beyond rollbacks? run a policy simulation across roles for the last week of traffic.

devon: running simulation. preliminary: only console SA paths that triggered KMS timeouts saw operator mapping. small blast radius (about 12 users).

kevin_m: okay scope manageable. we'll rotate tokens for those SA entries, patch mapping, add audit fields, and schedule a postmortem sync.

tess: deploy patch to staging now, will run canary with strict auth. tagging @sara.h for verification.

sara.h: verifying — staging canary passed auth checks, no unauthorized operator mapping. good.

security-oncall: filing incident ticket with severity P2, include attack/accident vector, mitigation timeline, and list of affected principals.

devon: PR up: short-circuit + metrics + unit tests. request review from @kevin_m and @sara.h.

sara.h: reviewing now. :eyes: make sure we include log correlation id for KMS failures so audit replay can link to rollback events.

kevin_m: approving, will merge on green. also scheduling a KMS integration DR test to validate latency SLAs so fallback doesn't trigger in normal conditions.

sara.h: thanks all. follow-up: postmortem and action items — (1) revert permissive inference, (2) add structured fallback audit entries, (3) rotate SA tokens affected, (4) KMS DR checks. I'll create the postmortem doc.

audit-bot: Audit replay queued for 24h window. Results will be posted to the incident ticket.

deploy-bot: Production feature-flag `canary.ui_control_enabled` set to false by tess at 1772550200.
